_comment: Declared sourcing classes for components that carry no exact MPN.
audit_bom.py resolves every non-DNP component to either an MPN in the
schematic or exactly one entry here. Anything resolving to neither is a
FAIL, not a silent omission: the Rev A basket was transcribed by hand and
the parts carrying a value family instead of an MPN were never ordered.
Keys are '<footprint>|<value>', matched exactly. A '*' value is permitted
only for the not-purchased class, where the whole footprint is a land
pattern rather than a procurable item.
generic-stock may NOT be declared for a value carrying a load-bearing
specification (tolerance, dielectric, voltage, shielding, trip current).
Buying those to a family name is the defect this audit exists to catch.

classes.generic-stock: Bought to value + package from generic reel stock; no further specification is load-bearing at this circuit position.
classes.not-purchased: Land pattern with no procurable item: bare test pad or solder-wire pigtail.
classes.custom: Procured outside distributor channels; frozen by a named FAB-READINESS.md gate rather than by an MPN.

Capacitor_SMD:C_0402_1005Metric|100n.rationale: Local IC decoupling; 16 V X7R or better from stock.

Capacitor_SMD:C_0603_1608Metric|10n.rationale: Signal-path filter; value tolerance non-critical at this node.

Capacitor_SMD:C_1206_3216Metric|22u.rationale: Bulk bypass; DC-bias derating covered by the 1206 package choice.

Resistor_SMD:R_0603_1608Metric|10R.rationale: RS-485 series element (R2/R3) and the +5V_ANALOG prefilter (R32); 1% from stock. R32 was an 0805 option pad for a ferrite bead; 0603 beads are as available, so the option survived the package.

TestPoint:TestPoint_Pad_D1.0mm|*.rationale: Bare copper probe pad; nothing is placed.

Connector_Wire:SolderWire-0.25sqmm_1x01_.rationale: Solder-wire pigtail land; the J1 cable is a separate assembly item.

o2-probe:SolderWire_RaisedRelief_1x01|*.rationale: J103/J104 solder-wire lands; unchanged plated/relief holes with wire-envelope graphics on the assembly layer. The cable is a separate assembly item.

o2-probe:SolderWireNoRelief_J105|*.rationale: Accepted J105 bare solder-wire land; there is no connector body to purchase.

Connector:Tag-Connect_TC2030-IDC-NL_2x03.rationale: J3 is bare programming pads and alignment holes; no connector body is placed. The reusable TC2030 cable/holding fixture is a separate programming tool.

o2-probe:Ring_Fork_Tip_DRAFT|*.rationale: J5 is bare main-board solder lands. The separate ring PCB and its measured fork interface remain unfrozen FAB-READINESS.md gates; this declaration supplies neither that assembly nor approval to fabricate it.

o2-probe:SolderWireNoRelief_J106|*.rationale: Accepted J106 bare solder-wire land; there is no connector body to purchase.
